query: SELECT id,user_id,session_id FROM (SELECT id,user_id,session_id FROM plugin_usage_events WHERE $1='plugin_usage_events' UNION ALL SELECT id,user_id,client_session_id AS session_id FROM ai_requests WHERE $1='ai_requests' UNION ALL SELECT session_id AS id,user_id,session_id FROM session_analyses WHERE $1='session_analyses') rows WHERE id>$2 ORDER BY id LIMIT $3
